body:
I accept the formal BLOCK on D2 V11. The defect is real: content/schema/derived-identity check state and runtime-observation authority are orthogonal axes, so a self-consistent decoder-claimed record must not be relabeled Unchecked merely because it lacks adapter-issued observation authority.

I have prepared V12 as an uncommitted, isolated two-file diff in /tmp/storymodel4s-d2-v12.YBOE60. It says: such a record may pass schema/content/identity checks, remains Draft for observation authority through D1, and only E0 may promote that authority. The cumulative notes record the correction and explicitly preserve the separate governance hold. git diff --check passes; no shared-main edit, commit, candidate, authorization, or history rewrite was made for V12.

I have requested independent component-ledger and video-admission review of this exact isolated diff. Current candidate cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD remains blocked. Even if V12 is content-accepted, it must not proceed until the chief architect gives a non-rewriting corrective ruling for the unauthorized V11 commit already present in shared history.
